notes.title: Lots of progress on Mother Hub
notes.content:
[h1][b]Progress list dump so you guys can see stuff is happening.[/b][/h1]

This month I did two things, recreated the menu, and recreated the journal. What this means is a rethought out the process and made it so much more clean and professional.

Turn off locomotion handler for jumping during menu with controller
Select button menu when opening it for controller
Detect if joystick button was used to open menu, - element select button (for navigation with controller)
open menu on controller button
Test controller with menu
Disable language select for now
Disable tutorial mode for now
Turn auto nav off for everything on controls besides look sens and invert
Keep mouse locked if opened with joystick
If returning to a previously seen tab it doesn’t reselect the button
If pressing b inside of settings tab it fully exits instead of returning to main menu tab
Check navigation on visual menu
Add UI L stick to show when on sliders (check if it works by just using it on button and not the slider)
Exit with b from panels to menu not reselecting default button
Controller settings set it explicit to only select each other (see if you can still scroll)
Visuals - when selecting the “title” button you can use R stick to cycle, make sure only titles are selectable, R stick works for window mode anti alias, textures, texture filter, shadow quality, need a way to select resolution when opened
There is an issue switching between tabs and the previous menu keeps the selected button, I believe this is because there is about a second delay between one tab opening and another closing this could result in not selecting the right button because technically two tabs are open and it gets confused. To further describe the issue, I open up a tab, which selects a button, then I go to the next tab and I can tell taht even though the previous tab is closed it’s selecting buttons on that closed tab still somehow, instead of moving to the next tab and selecting the button it’s suppose to.
Add load button with confirm
Quit brings you to the main menu screen
Save mouse settings player prefs
Connect brightness slider to detect camera - brightness, share the script first so it knows what to look for.
Can we pause all audio for menu open?

notes.title: Announcing a new game: Habilis
notes.content:
[b]Habilis[/b] is a sinister-dark, 45 minute, first-person bodycam-style, Lovecraft horror game.


Follow Nathan Walters as he quickly descends into insanity. Discover the ancient secrets held within a futuristic abandoned factory. A bodycam, Lovecraft style horror experience not for the weak of heart. Hide, and survive if you can. 

[list]
[*]     Explore beautifully rendered science fiction style facility in the near future.
[*]     A handcrafted tale of one man’s descent into insanity and extreme sickness.
[*]     All dialogue voice acted by an all star cast of professionals.
[*]     Incredible, and unique music shaped to fit every scene
[*]     A short but sweet 45 minutes of non stop entertainment.
[*]     An adventure that isn’t for the weak of heart.
[/list]

Check it out and wishlist below:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3121600/Habilis/

notes.title: A bunch of fixes and improvements
notes.content:
Removed text about destroying everything

Made it so all except first contamination road block are able to pass through without breaking stuff

Changed computer text on starting computer to not incentivize destroying the terrain.

[b]Thought: After reading szederpg’s review I decided to dial back to destroying the environment for supplies, they brought up a good point that it feels like mashing the “use” button to find a secret door. Instead ammo boxes and backpacks will be found around. You can still destroy terrain, it will still give you items, but you don’t have to go around hitting everything in hope of getting ammo or hp.[/b]

Covered up tool box that I original made give ammo as an Easter egg because it comes off more as a glitch, the truth is the tool box is baked into the environment.

[b]Changed position of dialogue text, increased font size[/b]

Added new destroy-able item Locker to find ammo

Reduced decay time of bodies from 25 to 10

Some optimizing of zombies (to increase FPS)

Changing to last computer text

[b]Increased zombie head hit box (this should make less missing or feels bad with the pipe)[/b]

Added puss volumetric effect to bloat flies

Non breakable glass will no longer shatter when hit

Fixed issue where key card from body option wouldn’t disappear when taken


In the works:
Physics based hit reaction system for monsters
Toggle “e” to hold objects instead of hold

notes.title: "Blood and Immersion" Update is live
notes.content:
[b]All levels[/b]
Volumetric blood (blood that sprays out and lands on objects)
Added environmental story telling
Blood just like... everywhere.
Backpacks and boxes! New breakable objects giving small amount of of health and ammo.

[b]The idea was for this patch to tone back the amount of health from medical boxes, and the amount of ammo from ammo clips, and make the player "live off the land" I think this feels way more true to my original vision.[/b]

reworked visual effects
reworked textures

body decay set to 30 seconds
bodies no longer trip up or stop the players movement
